package.description: A small suite of command-line amateur-radio tools (qrz, qte, dxsummit, dxheat, holycluster).

en-US.description: A small suite of command-line amateur-radio tools (qrz, qte, dxsummit, dxheat, holycluster).
en-US.longDescription: ham-tools is a suite of command-line amateur-radio utilities written in C: QRZ.com callsign lookup (qrz), address-to-bearing/grid-square lookup (qte), and live DX-cluster viewers for DX Summit, DXHeat and HolyCluster.
en-US.name: ham-tools
